fail_closed_rules: Sold Prior or Sold Post without a disclosed consideration does not receive an inferred price.
Withdrawn Prior or Withdrawn Post is not represented as a completed sale.
Seller top-ups, rent concessions and gross/net income are kept distinct from passing rent.
Future indexed or fixed rent changes are not treated as current unless independently completed and verified.
Proposed leases, licences, S26 requests and planning-dependent transactions are not treated as completed.
Development and alternative-use potential remains subject to lease and consents.
Historical tenancy facts are kept separate from current registry status.
